identity.operation: ParseFromString parses an OBJ vertex without RGB components.
identity.capability: Accept the vertex while leaving fallback colors absent.
identity.consequence: The vertex cannot be handled with fallback colors disabled, or fallback colors are supplied.

requirement: With vertex-color fallback disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.

assessment.necessity_reason: ParseFromString supports parsing an uncolored OBJ vertex with vertex_color=false and no fallback colors. The complete old harness always passes a default configuration whose vertex_color is true; input bytes cannot change that setting.

before.requirement: Parse an OBJ vertex without RGB components with vertex_color=false, leaving fallback colors absent.
before.reason: The old loader accepts the vertex and clears colors when fallback is disabled. The harness never disables fallback.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The vertex parser reports absent RGB components and supplies white values for fallback.
ObjReaderConfig exposes vertex_color and defaults it to true.

after.requirement: Parse an OBJ vertex without RGB components with vertex_color=false, leaving fallback colors absent.
after.reason: The changed loader retains the disabled fallback behavior. The same harness still passes vertex_color=true.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The vertex parser identifies a vertex without RGB components.
ObjReaderConfig still defaults vertex_color to true.
ParseFromString still forwards config.vertex_color to LoadObj.

assessment.comparison_reason: Both versions support the same disabled fallback behavior. The old harness's default configuration blocks it on both sides.

necessity_evidence.reason: ParseFromString supports an uncolored OBJ vertex with vertex_color=false and no fallback colors. The old harness always passes a default configuration with vertex_color=true, so input bytes cannot reach that behavior. The same blocker exists before and after the source change.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Input bytes: 76 20 30 20 30 20 30 0a 00 78, representing OBJ text "v 0 0 0\n", a NUL separator, and MTL text "x". With the supported setup config.vertex_color=false, parsing succeeds and colors remain empty. The harness instead passes vertex_color=true.

scope_contract.reason: The target calls ParseFromString on OBJ text. Its configuration contract exposes vertex_color=false, and the called loader uses that setting for vertex color fallback.

evidence.dependency_reason: ParseFromString forwards config.vertex_color to the loader.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite NUL-separated input supplies a valid uncolored OBJ vertex. The parser recognizes its absent RGB components, and a supported false configuration selects the no-fallback behavior that the target setup blocks.

evidence.dependency_reason: The vertex parser distinguishes a vertex without RGB components.

observable_consequence.reason: With fallback disabled, the loader leaves colors empty for the uncolored vertex. With the harness's default true setting, it supplies fallback color components instead. The supported no-fallback result is unreachable.

evidence.dependency_reason: The loader transfers the resulting color vector to the reader attributes and returns success.
The harness's default configuration sets vertex_color=true.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete harness constructs one default configuration, never changes it, and makes one ParseFromString call. The supplied earlier uncertainty about the default is resolved by the before and after constructors: both set vertex_color=true. OBJ or MTL bytes cannot select false through this call sequence.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before configuration exposes vertex_color and defaults it to true.
The after configuration retains the true default.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—ParseFromString, an uncolored vertex, vertex_color=false, and absent fallback colors—is supported in both versions and blocked by the same unchanged harness configuration.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before configuration defines the fallback setting and its default.
The after configuration defines the same setting and default.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: ParseFromString accepts an OBJ vertex without RGB components while leaving fallback colors absent when vertex_color=false.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Pass an ObjReaderConfig with vertex_color=false and an OBJ string containing an uncolored vertex.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness passes a default ObjReaderConfig whose vertex_color is true.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The harness cannot reach successful parsing of an uncolored vertex with fallback colors absent under vertex_color=false.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete supplied harness: input bytes supply only OBJ and MTL text, while the single call forwards the unchanged default configuration.
